scope.summary: This standard specifies the dimensions of solid carbide end mills with continuous parallel shank.

requirements.detail: The raw solid carbide material must belong to chip removal group P or K in accordance with IS 2428. The specific application group and grade class (such as K40) are chosen at the manufacturer's discretion or subject to agreement.
End mills are designated by name, nominal cutting diameter, number of flutes (Z), carbide grade class, and the standard number. Example: 'End Mill 6.00 Z4 K40 IS 16136'.
Tolerances on both cutting diameters (d1) and shank diameters (d2) must conform strictly to standard ISO limits specified in IS 919 (Part 2).
Unless otherwise specified, end mills must be supplied with a right-hand helix combined with a right-hand cutting direction.
End mills with non-standard intermediate cutting diameters may be supplied subject to prior agreement between the manufacturer and the purchaser.

plain_language_summary.summary: IS 16136 : 2013 is the national Indian Standard specification governing solid carbide end mills manufactured with a continuous parallel shank. Finalized by the Cutting Tools Sectional Committee (PGD 32), this standard defines precise dimensional sizing boundaries (for diameters up to 20.00 mm), overall lengths, and shank gripping parameters for both short and long flute series. To ensure optimal chip flow and tool performance in high-speed milling machines, the standard mandates raw carbide grade categories (Group P or K conforming to IS 2428), enforces strict diameter tolerances per IS 919 (Part 2), regulates flute length tolerances up to +2.0 mm, and prescribes N6 grinding finishes for active cutting surfaces and shank diameters.
